purpose: Run the pre-specified BRTI direction-calibration audit only on timestamp-supported market-checkpoints, with a same-decision-time causal Kalshi book-mid benchmark.

sources.raw_envelopes: The 72 deterministic-gzip V3 authoritative history envelopes bound by the V3 receipt.
sources.pre_analysis_value_access: The sealed acquisition validator checked that raw value fields were finite positive numerics; no value was output, summarized, modeled, compared with an outcome, or inspected when this analysis was designed.

support_gate.metadata_rule: The two finalized catalog markets whose floor_strike is null are excluded as METADATA_STRIKE_MISSING at all three horizons. Never infer their strike from result, expiration_value, a neighboring market, or any BRTI value.
support_gate.rule: Include a market-checkpoint if and only if timestamp_support_manifest marks analysis_checkpoint_supported=true. Exclude all other checkpoints with the manifest reasons. Never interpolate, carry forward, substitute a neighboring 200ms row, or change a support decision after reading values.
support_gate.minimum_reportable: At least 20 unique included markets and both outcomes; otherwise descriptive/NO_DECISION.

value_projection.rule: Use only the raw row at the exact second boundary. Never sample by row position.

market_and_settlement.settlement_crosscheck: For manifest-supported settlement windows only, require exact 60 projected one-second values in [close-60s,close), compute raw mean, and require mean>=floor_strike to equal official result. Any mismatch is excluded and reported; never alter the extraction rule.

kernel.tick_selection: Latest exact-boundary BRTI source timestamp at or before target-2s, cutoff-source gap <=1.5s; support manifest already fixes admissibility.
kernel.sigma60: Non-demeaned timestamp-aware diffusion over strict trailing 60s.
kernel.sigma300: Non-demeaned timestamp-aware diffusion over strict trailing 300s.

book_mid.reconstruction: Snapshot replaces both maps; signed delta adds at exact side/price; never clamp or repair.
book_mid.market_stream_failures: Any missing/ambiguous receive clock, non-increasing receive key, delta before snapshot, unknown side/update semantics, invalid level, or negative displayed quantity rejects that entire market stream.
book_mid.sampling: At each target decision wall-clock, use the latest reconstructed two-sided book with recv_wall_ns<=target_ns.
book_mid.yes_mid: (best positive YES bid + (1-best positive NO bid))/2
book_mid.comparison: Kernel and market mid are reported side by side on the exact paired included market-checkpoints. Missing/invalid book mid reduces paired n and is reported.

primary_metrics.unit: One row per manifest-supported, settlement-crosschecked market per fixed horizon.
primary_metrics.uncertainty: Market-cluster bootstrap, 2000 replicates, seed 26072611, percentile 95% confidence intervals.
primary_metrics.interpretation: Negative paired score differences favor the kernel; positive differences favor market mid.

separate_lead_report.reason: Historical CF rows provide source time/value but not their original Kalshi receipt time. A causal fair-to-future-mid lead test cannot mix BRTI source time with book receive time.
separate_lead_report.rule: Report this identification failure separately from settlement calibration. Do not compute a lead coefficient, hit rate, markout, or CI.

execution_boundary.deployment: No result authorizes trading or parameter changes.
